name: PEDESTRIAN_PRECINCT_YELLOWGREEN_LONG
notes: DIT SA Standard Road Sign Index sheet (A4, legends and dimensions outlined, colour legend; size from the sheet's size table = register). Every dimension from the sheet; AS 1744 (plus0) spacing. The sheet's two edge figures are the edge strip (ground colour) and edge + black border, as the AS 1743 drawings. Sheet W8-SA106 (two sizes drawn, each with its own dimensions): W8-SA106B 750 x 400, fluorescent yellow-green, R50, 10 / 30. PEDESTRIAN 90 C baseline 170, 585 (85/585/80); PRECINCT 90 C baseline 320 (150 pitch, 80 below), 470 (140/470/140). Use under a variable speed limit sign only.
